en_US: Where did you say you’re from?
New Bark Town?
That’s the town where...
Professor Elm lives, right?
You’ve come a long way to get here.
Oh! Are you a tourist?
You should take a look around
the wonders of Ecruteak City!
Explore the Burned and Bell towers!
Challenge the gym! It’s worth it!
Boss Pokémon have been unlocked in
Route 37 and the Ruins of Alph!
Oh! Are you a tourist?
You should take a look around Ecruteak!
Explore the towers! Challenge the gym!
You... You wouldn’t happen to be
{STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}, would you?
Ah, sorry, I should introduce myself.
My name is Steven.
I’m the Champion of the Hoenn Region.
Steven: Cynthia told me about a young
trainer who seemed different from the
rest...
I can see what she meant immediately.
Ahem!
Do you remember the story about the
Legendary Trainer that Cynthia
told you?
Another part of that story involves
the collection of Plates, special
items that resonate with the
Pokémon god.
It’s said there are sixteen in total,
and they are scattered across the
Johto and Kanto regions, as well
as very far north.
Each Plate represents an element,
such as Fire, Water, Electric, Steel...
They could be found anywhere. In the
modern age, they’re probably either
held by enthusiasts, buried in the
ground, or even just picked up by
random people.
In fact, I wouldn’t be surprised if
one had ended up in the bin of a
research lab...
How do I know these Plates exist?
Because I’ve already located one!
This is the Iron Plate, the Plate that
represents the element of Steel.
I’d like to leave it in your capable
hands, however. It can give your
Pokémon a small boost to some of their
moves, too, so it’ll be helpful!
Here. Don’t drop it!
You should try looking for the rest of
those Plates. You might even help
prove the legend true!
Well, it was nice meeting you--but until
we cross paths again, this is goodbye.
